blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bishops from Capiz province have urged government and business leaders to heed the Diocese of Kalibo’s concerns about the consequences of gambling’s proliferation following the opening of a casino hub in Boracay. The Diocese of Kalibo recently reiterated its opposition to gambling and its implications for the lives of many Filipinos who engage in it. This came after a six-story casino hub opened at Station 0 in Barangay Yapak, Municipality of Malay, on Boracay Island. In a solidarity statement, Bishops Victor Bendico (Metropolitan Archbishop of Capiz) and Narciso Abellana (Bishop of Romblon) said the concerns expressed by the […]...
